+"""Jobs-to-be-Done CLI subcommands."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import typer
+
+from cli.backend import Backend
+
+jobs_app = typer.Typer(help="Manage Jobs-to-be-Done.")
+
+
+def _backend(ctx: typer.Context) -> Backend:
+    backend: Backend | None = ctx.obj
+    if backend is None:
+        typer.echo("Error: no backend configured", err=True)
+        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
+    return backend
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("add")
+def add(
+    ctx: typer.Context,
+    name: str = typer.Option(..., help="Job name"),
+    description: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="Job description"),
+) -> None:
+    """Add a new Job."""
+    args: dict[str, Any] = {"name": name}
+    if description is not None:
+        args["description"] = description
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("add_job", args))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("list")
+def list_jobs(ctx: typer.Context) -> None:
+    """List all Jobs."""
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("get_jobs", {}))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("get")
+def get(ctx: typer.Context, job_id: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Job ID")) -> None:
+    """Get a Job by ID."""
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("get_job", {"job_id": job_id}))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("update")
+def update(
+    ctx: typer.Context,
+    job_id: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Job ID"),
+    name: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="New job name"),
+    description: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="New job description"),
+) -> None:
+    """Update an existing Job."""
+    args: dict[str, Any] = {"job_id": job_id}
+    if name is not None:
+        args["name"] = name
+    if description is not None:
+        args["description"] = description
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("update_job", args))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("delete")
+def delete(
+    ctx: typer.Context,
+    job_id: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Job ID"),
+    yes: bool = typer.Option(False, "--yes", "-y", help="Skip confirmation"),
+) -> None:
+    """Delete a Job."""
+    if not yes:
+        confirm = typer.confirm(f"Delete job {job_id}?")
+        if not confirm:
+            raise typer.Exit()
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("delete_job", {"job_id": job_id}))

+    )

+
+    fetched = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id])
+
+    assert fetched.exit_code == 0
+    payload = json.loads(fetched.output)
+    assert payload["name"] == "Write docs"
+    assert payload["description"] == "draft"
+

+    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
+    runner = CliRunner()

+    )

Hand-crafted static HTML + one CSS file + ≤100 lines of vanilla JS. **No framework** (no
Astro/Next/React): one page with no routing, no state, no data, no components shared across
views — a framework buys a toolchain, a lockfile, hydration, and an upgrade treadmill, and charges
rent on every one of them. Consequence of no framework: deploy is "copy files", the review diff is
readable HTML, Lighthouse is high by construction, and there is zero supply chain on the page.

```
website/
  index.html            # the site
  404.html              # self-contained fallback
  assets/
    style.css           # tokens + full design system (no external URLs)
    main.js             # ≤100 lines: reveal + copy buttons, defer, progressive enhancement
    mark.svg  favicon.svg
    og.png    favicon.png   # committed, generated (see OG strategy)
  tools/
    make_og.py          # regenerates og.png + favicon.png (Pillow, pinned)
  tests/
    test_site.py  test_assets.py  test_make_og.py
    test_workflows.py  test_readme_sync.py
```

- **Paths:** every in-page URL is **relative** (`assets/…`, `#anchor`) so the site works under the
  project-Pages base `/agentic-odi/`, on a local static server, and on any future custom domain.
  `og:url` / `og:image` / `rel=canonical` are **absolute**.
- Local preview: `python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory website` (preview the 404 by opening
  `/404.html` directly — `http.server` serves its own 404).
- JS is `defer`'d and additive: the page is complete, styled, and readable with JS disabled.
- Python tooling lives only in `tools/` + `tests/`, run from the repo root with the workspace venv.

## OG / Social Strategy

Social previews are the main earned-distribution artifact — one committed raster, no mystery binary.

- `website/assets/og.png`: **1200×630**, fixed dark card — mark + "Agentic ODI" wordmark,
  headline "Your roadmap is a guess.", sub "Verified customer outcomes, jobs, and opportunity
  scores — served over MCP.", bottom row `alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi` + Experimental badge.
- `website/tools/make_og.py`: the committed, runnable generator (stdlib argparse + Pillow). Writes
  `og.png` and `favicon.png`; defaults embed the canonical card copy above. Deterministic output —
  fixed palette/positions, no timestamps, `compress_level=9`, font via
  `ImageFont.load_default(size=…)` (Pillow's embedded Aileron, SIL OFL — no font file in the repo).
  Run: `uv run python website/tools/make_og.py`.
- **Regenerability is enforced:** `test_make_og.py` renders fresh bytes and asserts they are
  pixel-identical to the committed PNGs. Change the script → the test fails until you regenerate.
  Change the card copy → defaults in the script are the source.
- Meta contract on `index.html`: `og:type=website`, `og:site_name`, `og:title`
  ("Your roadmap is a guess. — Agentic ODI"), `og:description`, `og:url` (canonical Pages URL),
  `og:image` (absolute PNG URL), `twitter:card=summary_large_image` + title/description/image,

- og:image is never loaded by the page itself (page weight unaffected).
- No OpenGraph on SVG: scrapers (X, LinkedIn, Slack, iMessage) need raster — hence exactly one PNG.

"""Generate the committed social art: website/assets/og.png and favicon.png.

Run from the repo root:

    uv run python website/tools/make_og.py

Output is deterministic - fixed palette, fixed positions, no timestamps, PNG
encoded with compress_level=9 and optimize=True - so website/tests/test_make_og.py
can assert the committed PNGs are pixel-identical to a fresh render.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import io
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

OG_SIZE = (1200, 630)
FAVICON_SIZE = (32, 32)

DEFAULT_HEADLINE = "Your roadmap is a guess."
DEFAULT_SUBHEAD = "Verified customer outcomes, jobs, and opportunity scores — served over MCP."
DEFAULT_URL = "alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi"

CANVAS = (11, 13, 19)  # #0b0d13
SURFACE = (19, 23, 34)  # #131722
TEXT = (241, 245, 249)  # #f1f5f9
MUTED = (148, 163, 184)  # #94a3b8
ACCENT = (64, 156, 255)  # #409cff
BADGE_FG = (203, 213, 225)  # #cbd5e1
BADGE_BG = (30, 41, 59)  # #1e293b
HAIRLINE = (51, 65, 85)  # #334155

MARGIN = 64
PILL_LABEL = "Experimental"
WORDMARK = "Agentic ODI"
HEADLINE_SIZES = (84, 76, 68, 60, 52)  # shrink until the headline fits two lines

# Mark geometry, normalized inside its bounding box: an ascending two-step
# polyline (flat, riser, flat, riser, flat) ending in a filled apex dot.
_MARK_POINTS = (
    (0.16, 0.78),
    (0.42, 0.78),
    (0.42, 0.53),
    (0.66, 0.53),
    (0.66, 0.28),
    (0.84, 0.28),
)


def _wrap(
    draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw,
    text: str,
    font: ImageFont.ImageFont,
    max_width: float,
) -> list[str]:
    """Greedy word wrap measured with draw.textlength."""
    lines: list[str] = []
    current = ""
    for word in text.split():
        candidate = word if not current else f"{current} {word}"
        if draw.textlength(candidate, font=font) <= max_width:
            current = candidate
        elif current:
            lines.append(current)
            current = word
        else:
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines


def _draw_mark(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], line_width: int) -> None:
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    width = x1 - x0 + 1
    height = y1 - y0 + 1
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        box, radius=max(2, width // 4), fill=SURFACE, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1
    )
    points = [(x0 + px * (width - 1), y0 + py * (height - 1)) for px, py in _MARK_POINTS]
    draw.line(points, fill=ACCENT, width=line_width, joint="curve")
    apex_x, apex_y = points[-1]
    radius = max(2, round(width * 0.09))
    draw.ellipse(
        (apex_x - radius, apex_y - radius, apex_x + radius, apex_y + radius),
        fill=ACCENT,
    )


def _draw_pill(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, label: str, right: int, cy: int) -> None:
    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=22)
    pad_x = 20
    height = 44
    width = round(draw.textlength(label, font=font)) + 2 * pad_x
    x1, y0 = right, cy - height // 2
    x0, y1 = x1 - width, y0 + height
    draw.rounded_rectangle((x0, y0, x1, y1), radius=height // 2, fill=BADGE_BG)
    draw.text(((x0 + x1) / 2, cy), label, font=font, fill=BADGE_FG, anchor="mm")


def _to_png(image: Image.Image) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(buffer, format="PNG", compress_level=9, optimize=True)
    return buffer.getvalue()


def render(
    headline: str = DEFAULT_HEADLINE,
    subhead: str = DEFAULT_SUBHEAD,
    url: str = DEFAULT_URL,
) -> bytes:
    """Render the 1200x630 social card and return its PNG bytes."""
    width, height = OG_SIZE
    image = Image.new("RGB", OG_SIZE, CANVAS)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (24, 24, width - 25, height - 25), radius=28, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1
    )

    mark_size = 44
    _draw_mark(draw, (MARGIN, MARGIN, MARGIN + mark_size - 1, MARGIN + mark_size - 1), 3)
    middle_y = MARGIN + mark_size // 2
    draw.text(
        (MARGIN + mark_size + 16, middle_y),
        WORDMARK,
        font=ImageFont.load_default(size=30),
        fill=TEXT,
        anchor="lm",
    )
    _draw_pill(draw, PILL_LABEL, right=width - MARGIN, cy=middle_y)

    text_width = width - 2 * MARGIN
    size = HEADLINE_SIZES[0]
    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
    headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
    for size in HEADLINE_SIZES[1:]:
        if len(headline_lines) <= 2:
            break
        font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
        headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)

    y = 200
    for line in headline_lines[:2]:
        draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=font, fill=TEXT)
        y += round(size * 1.25)

    subhead_font = ImageFont.load_default(size=28)
    y += 26
    for line in _wrap(draw, subhead, subhead_font, text_width):
        draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=subhead_font, fill=MUTED)
        y += 36

    draw.text(
        (MARGIN, height - MARGIN),
        url,
        font=ImageFont.load_default(size=26),
        fill=MUTED,
        anchor="ld",
    )
    return _to_png(image)


def render_favicon() -> bytes:
    """Render the 32x32 favicon tile (canvas + mark only) as PNG bytes."""
    image = Image.new("RGB", FAVICON_SIZE, CANVAS)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    _draw_mark(draw, (2, 2, 29, 29), 2)
    return _to_png(image)


def write(out_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    """Write og.png and favicon.png into out_dir and return their paths."""
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    og_path = out_dir / "og.png"
    favicon_path = out_dir / "favicon.png"
    og_path.write_bytes(render())
    favicon_path.write_bytes(render_favicon())
    return [og_path, favicon_path]


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate the site's og.png and favicon.png.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assets",
        help="directory to write og.png and favicon.png into (default: website/assets)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    for path in write(args.out):
        print(f"wrote {path}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import importlib.util
import io
import struct
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TOOLS = ROOT / "website" / "tools"
ASSETS = ROOT / "website" / "assets"


def _load():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("make_og", TOOLS / "make_og.py")
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def _dims(png: bytes) -> tuple[int, int]:
    assert png[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "not a PNG"
    w, h = struct.unpack(">II", png[16:24])  # IHDR: 8 sig + 4 len + 4 type, then width/height
    return w, h


def test_render_is_deterministic_and_sized():
    m = _load()
    a = m.render()
    b = m.render()
    assert _dims(a) == (1200, 630)
    assert a == b


def test_favicon_is_sized():
    m = _load()
    assert _dims(m.render_favicon()) == (32, 32)


def test_cli_writes_both_files_to_out_dir(tmp_path):
    m = _load()
    assert m.main(["--out", str(tmp_path)]) == 0
    assert _dims((tmp_path / "og.png").read_bytes()) == (1200, 630)
    assert _dims((tmp_path / "favicon.png").read_bytes()) == (32, 32)


def test_committed_art_matches_generator():
    """Regenerate committed PNGs (uv run python website/tools/make_og.py) whenever the script changes."""
    from PIL import Image

    m = _load()
    fresh = Image.open(io.BytesIO(m.render()))
    committed = Image.open(ASSETS / "og.png")
    assert committed.format == "PNG"
    assert fresh.size == committed.size == (1200, 630)
    assert fresh.tobytes() == committed.tobytes()
    fresh_fav = Image.open(io.BytesIO(m.render_favicon()))
    committed_fav = Image.open(ASSETS / "favicon.png")
    assert fresh_fav.tobytes() == committed_fav.tobytes()


def test_committed_og_size_budget():
    assert (ASSETS / "og.png").stat().st_size < 300_000

"""Generate the committed social art: website/assets/og.png and favicon.png.

Run from the repo root:

    uv run python website/tools/make_og.py

Output is deterministic - fixed palette, fixed positions, no timestamps, PNG

"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import io
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

OG_SIZE = (1200, 630)
FAVICON_SIZE = (32, 32)

DEFAULT_HEADLINE = "Your roadmap is a guess."
DEFAULT_SUBHEAD = "Verified customer outcomes, jobs, and opportunity scores — served over MCP."
DEFAULT_URL = "alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi"

CANVAS = (11, 13, 19)  # #0b0d13
SURFACE = (19, 23, 34)  # #131722
TEXT = (241, 245, 249)  # #f1f5f9
MUTED = (148, 163, 184)  # #94a3b8
ACCENT = (64, 156, 255)  # #409cff
BADGE_FG = (203, 213, 225)  # #cbd5e1
BADGE_BG = (30, 41, 59)  # #1e293b
HAIRLINE = (51, 65, 85)  # #334155

MARGIN = 64
PILL_LABEL = "Experimental"
WORDMARK = "Agentic ODI"
HEADLINE_SIZES = (84, 76, 68, 60, 52)  # shrink until the headline fits two lines

# Mark geometry, normalized inside its bounding box: an ascending two-step
# polyline (flat, riser, flat, riser, flat) ending in a filled apex dot.
_MARK_POINTS = (
    (0.16, 0.78),
    (0.42, 0.78),
    (0.42, 0.53),
    (0.66, 0.53),
    (0.66, 0.28),
    (0.84, 0.28),
)


def _wrap(
    draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw,
    text: str,
    font: ImageFont.ImageFont,
    max_width: float,
) -> list[str]:
    """Greedy word wrap measured with draw.textlength."""
    lines: list[str] = []
    current = ""
    for word in text.split():
        candidate = word if not current else f"{current} {word}"
        if draw.textlength(candidate, font=font) <= max_width:
            current = candidate
        elif current:
            lines.append(current)
            current = word
        else:
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    return lines


def _draw_mark(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], line_width: int) -> None:
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    width = x1 - x0 + 1
    height = y1 - y0 + 1
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=max(2, width // 4), fill=SURFACE, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1)
    points = [(x0 + px * (width - 1), y0 + py * (height - 1)) for px, py in _MARK_POINTS]
    draw.line(points, fill=ACCENT, width=line_width, joint="curve")
    apex_x, apex_y = points[-1]
    radius = max(2, round(width * 0.09))
    draw.ellipse(
        (apex_x - radius, apex_y - radius, apex_x + radius, apex_y + radius),
        fill=ACCENT,
    )


def _draw_pill(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, label: str, right: int, cy: int) -> None:
    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=22)
    pad_x = 20
    height = 44
    width = round(draw.textlength(label, font=font)) + 2 * pad_x
    x1, y0 = right, cy - height // 2
    x0, y1 = x1 - width, y0 + height
    draw.rounded_rectangle((x0, y0, x1, y1), radius=height // 2, fill=BADGE_BG)
    draw.text(((x0 + x1) / 2, cy), label, font=font, fill=BADGE_FG, anchor="mm")


def _to_png(image: Image.Image) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(buffer, format="PNG", compress_level=9, optimize=True)
    return buffer.getvalue()


def render(
    headline: str = DEFAULT_HEADLINE,
    subhead: str = DEFAULT_SUBHEAD,
    url: str = DEFAULT_URL,
) -> bytes:
    """Render the 1200x630 social card and return its PNG bytes."""
    width, height = OG_SIZE
    image = Image.new("RGB", OG_SIZE, CANVAS)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)

    draw.rounded_rectangle((24, 24, width - 25, height - 25), radius=28, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1)

    mark_size = 44
    _draw_mark(draw, (MARGIN, MARGIN, MARGIN + mark_size - 1, MARGIN + mark_size - 1), 3)
    middle_y = MARGIN + mark_size // 2
    draw.text(
        (MARGIN + mark_size + 16, middle_y),
        WORDMARK,
        font=ImageFont.load_default(size=30),
        fill=TEXT,
        anchor="lm",
    )
    _draw_pill(draw, PILL_LABEL, right=width - MARGIN, cy=middle_y)

    text_width = width - 2 * MARGIN
    size = HEADLINE_SIZES[0]
    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
    headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
    for size in HEADLINE_SIZES[1:]:
        if len(headline_lines) <= 2:
            break
        font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
        headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)

    y = 200
    for line in headline_lines[:2]:
        draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=font, fill=TEXT)
        y += round(size * 1.25)

    subhead_font = ImageFont.load_default(size=28)
    y += 26
    for line in _wrap(draw, subhead, subhead_font, text_width):
        draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=subhead_font, fill=MUTED)
        y += 36

    draw.text(
        (MARGIN, height - MARGIN),
        url,
        font=ImageFont.load_default(size=26),
        fill=MUTED,
        anchor="ld",
    )
    return _to_png(image)


def render_favicon() -> bytes:
    """Render the 32x32 favicon tile (canvas + mark only) as PNG bytes."""
    image = Image.new("RGB", FAVICON_SIZE, CANVAS)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    _draw_mark(draw, (2, 2, 29, 29), 2)
    return _to_png(image)


def write(out_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    """Write og.png and favicon.png into out_dir and return their paths."""
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    og_path = out_dir / "og.png"
    favicon_path = out_dir / "favicon.png"
    og_path.write_bytes(render())
    favicon_path.write_bytes(render_favicon())
    return [og_path, favicon_path]


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate the site's og.png and favicon.png.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assets",
        help="directory to write og.png and favicon.png into (default: website/assets)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    for path in write(args.out):
        print(f"wrote {path}")
    return 0

    raise SystemExit(main())
